title: Anita first sees Gil at Birdland; Bud Powell's birthday tape and marriage
summary: Anita recalls seeing Gil play at Birdland. They met through a birthday tape from Bud Powell and married almost at once.

story.theme_name: Meeting, marrying and raising a family
story.community_name: Meeting, courting and marrying: musicians' love lives

blocks.x: I went from highschool to see you do it at Bird Land on Basin Street somewhere. Gerry Mulligan Jerry Logan and, and something. I remember that
You mean to tell me that Gil was the attraction for you at that point too?
No, as a matter of fact no. I was put out because I thought somebody else was going to be on the piano. (LAUGHTER). But he turned out to be good. (LAUGHTER).
Well I think better than that, he turned out to be your husband.
I met her later through Bud Powell

That's when Bud Powell sent Anita a birthday tape and she didn't have a tape player. So, through a mutual friend she came to my house to play the tape and we were engaged and married immediately. (Imagine that?)?
And I met Bud in Paris, right?
